newsitem.title: USA: APAC sees '97 results hurt by client cost.
newsitem.headline: APAC sees '97 results hurt by client cost.

text.p: APAC TeleServices Inc said Monday it expects revenues, margins and earnings over the balance of 1997 will be hurt by costs for a large outsourcing client.

APAC said that first-quarter revenues, margins and earnings were hurt by a mutual decision for APAC to absorb certain costs related to staffing requirements at a large outsourcing client. The company did not give any further details, and a spokeswoman said no further information was available.
APAC, an outsourced customer service and sales company, operates 65 customer contact centers.
Earlier, it reported first quarter earnings of $0.18 a share, up from $0.10 a year ago.
First quarter operating expenses of $76.3 million were up from $40.6 million a year ago. Expenses included cost of services of $65.4 million in the first quarter, up from $34.4 million a year ago.
